Specification: This module is a very small TLA+ specification used to state a trivial initialization condition, a trivial next-state relation, and an invariant about the cardinality of a set. It models no concrete distributed algorithm or transition system with state variables, because there are no declared variables and both Init and Next are simply TRUE. The property being expressed is that the cardinality of the singleton set whose only element is the empty set is 1, and the module relies on FiniteSets for the Cardinality operator.
